label_independent_matching.pair_score: Jaccard intersection-over-union of member-node identity sets
label_independent_matching.tie_break: lexicographic order of the two sorted member-node identity sets
label_independent_matching.canonical_pair_order: descending pair score, then lexicographic left member set, then lexicographic right member set

unmatched_handling.left_unmatched: match to explicit EMPTY_RIGHT sentinel with zero overlap
unmatched_handling.right_unmatched: match to explicit EMPTY_LEFT sentinel with zero overlap

node_reassignment_rate.numerator: nodes whose matched community member set differs between the run pair
node_reassignment_rate.denominator: union of admitted node identities in both runs

unmatched_community_rate.denominator: left community count plus right community count

variation_of_information_bits.denominator: union of admitted node identities in both runs

pairwise_jaccard_summary.denominator: all matched pairs including unmatched sentinel pairs

thresholds.comparison_result: STABLE only when every threshold is satisfied for every complete pairwise comparison

run_accounting.pair_denominator: all unordered pairs of complete runs across all declared seeds, including same-seed replay pairs

failed_incomplete_policy.failed_run: typed failure remains in run denominator and blocks every incident comparison
failed_incomplete_policy.incomplete_run: typed incomplete remains in run denominator and blocks every incident comparison
failed_incomplete_policy.missing_run: treated as INCOMPLETE, never omitted or replaced

claim_ceiling: STABLE means only that the declared metrics met the declared thresholds for the exact bound graph, projection, implementation, parameters, seeds, and completed runs. It is label-independent, structural, and not a universal stability or semantic-community claim.
